visual.general_description: Six-panel grid (A to F, three rows by two columns) of colour anterior segment close-up photographs of eyes under slit-style illumination, with faint whitish spots visible in the cornea in the top row and fewer or no distinct spots in the lower rows at this resolution.
visual.detailed_description: Six-panel grid (A to F, three rows by two columns) of colour anterior segment close-up photographs of eyes under slit-style illumination, with faint whitish spots visible in the cornea in the top row and fewer or no distinct spots in the lower rows at this resolution. Panels A to F are lettered at the upper left. Panel A: Slit-lamp style close-up of an eye with a narrow bright beam crossing the cornea; a few small faint whitish-gray round spots are visible within the corneal area near its centre and upper part. Upper eyelid with eyelashes and a bright white reflection at the upper left. Panel B: Slit-lamp style close-up of an eye with a gray corneal beam area and a lit iris sector; several faint hazy whitish spots are visible in the corneal area, with eyelashes at the upper edge and a bright white glare at the upper left. Panel C: Close-up of an eye under slit illumination with a dark round pupil visible against a lit iris; the gray corneal beam area shows only very faint or no distinct discrete whitish spots at this resolution. Panel D: Slightly blurred close-up of an eye with a wide gray corneal beam band beside a bright orange-lit iris strip; one faint hazy whitish patch is visible near the middle of the beam band, close to its left edge. Panel E: Close-up of an eye with a brownish iris, a round central pupil with a gray-white appearance and a bright white reflection to its left; the cornea shows no distinct whitish spots at this resolution. Irregular bluish-white streaks lie at the lower right. Panel F: Close-up of an eye with a brown iris, a dark round pupil, bright white reflections to its left and the eyelid at the upper edge; no distinct whitish corneal spots are clearly discernible at this resolution.
